# REQ: LANG-811 LANG-812 LANG-813 LANG-814
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
PREFIX xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?name (COUNT(?friend) AS ?friends)
WHERE {
  ?person a foaf:Person ;
          foaf:name ?name ;
          foaf:age ?age .
  OPTIONAL { ?person foaf:knows ?friend }
  FILTER (?age < 40 && LANG(?name) = "en" && REGEX(?name, '^A', "i"))
}
GROUP BY ?name
ORDER BY DESC(?friends)
LIMIT 10
